summary: Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P., a Bermuda-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited interim condensed and consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, together with Canadian-law CEO and CFO certifications. No transaction, stake, price, premium or board recommendation is disclosed; the filing is a routine periodic reporting update. Structural notes: assets held for sale fell to $451M from $2,346M, and Brookfield Corporation holds an approximate 26.6% economic interest on a fully exchanged basis. No deal terms; no risk-arb angle applies.
